title: Be authorised before carrying on activities in the Antarctic
what: A person must be authorised by the Minister under Part 3 before carrying on an activity to which Part 3 applies in the Antarctic.

sources.title: Antarctic Treaty (Environment Protection) Act 1980
sources.quote: 21A Unauthorised activities (1) In this section: activity means an activity to which Part 3 applies. (2) A person commits an offence if: (a) the person carries on an activity; and (b) the person does so in the Antarctic; and (c) the person is not authorised by the Minister under Part 3 to carry on the activity.

reach.condition: if it carries on activities in the Antarctic to which Part 3 applies
